overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by not notifying the AG within 90 days that it had complied with prior order OML 2022-83, though the minutes themselves were created and approved as ordered.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to comply with a prior AG order (OML 2022-83) requiring creation and approval of outstanding minutes and certification to the AG.
allegations.key_passage: However, because the Board did not notify the Attorney General that it had done so within 90 days of the date of the order, we find the Board violated the Open Meeting Law as alleged.

allegations.summary: Whether the Board complied with the prior order to create and approve outstanding minutes of its September-December 2021 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We are satisfied that the Board has complied with our order to create and approve outstanding meeting minutes.

remedy: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
